parameters.name: Description
parameters.description: The name of the vServer group.

parameters.name: IncludeListener
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return information about the associated listeners. Valid values:

- **true**: yes

- **false** (default): no

parameters.name: IncludeRule
parameters.description:
Specifies whether to return the forwarding rules associated with the vServer groups. Valid values:

- **true**: yes

- **false** (default): no

parameters.name: LoadBalancerId
parameters.description: The ID of the CLB instance.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.

You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~27584~~) operation to query the most recent region list.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description:
The key of tag N. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag key cannot be an empty string.

The tag key can be up to 64 characters in length, and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`. The tag key cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs`:.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description:
The tag value. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. The tag value can be an empty string.

The tag value can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `acs:` or `aliyun`. The tag value cannot contain `http://` or `https://`.
